summary: First end-to-end testing pass for Ocean Studio (FiveM portfolio). Covered the full backend contract (site content merge/reset, role gating 401/403, chunked uploads 4MB with Range 206, extension/size/complete validations, products/facs/me-access regressions) and the frontend critical flows (public Home desktop + mobile, Admin Site editor save+reset+public reflect, Admin Arquivos upload + delete). 17/17 backend pytest cases passed. Frontend flows all working with only cosmetic observations.

minor.issue: POST route reads body-less but still enforces check_origin — fine; however admin_reset_site does not re-return merged site through merge_site (returns DEFAULT_SITE object directly). Non-blocking since GET /api/site re-merges on next load.
No garbage collection for abandoned upload_init rows / tmp files when complete is never called. Low priority.

issues: Text is forced to uppercase via CSS (text-transform). Editors in the admin should hint users that input is rendered uppercase so WYSIWYG expectation is clear.
GET /api/auth/me returns 401 for anonymous visitors and surfaces as a red console error on every public page load. Not a bug but noisy — consider silencing or returning 200 with null user.
Warning in console: 'Please ensure that the container has a non-static position...'. Framer-motion/Lenis integration warning; add position:relative to the scroll wrapper to silence.

action_items: (Optional) Silence /api/auth/me 401 for anonymous users (return 200 {user:null}) to avoid red console errors on public pages.
(Optional) Add position:relative to the SmoothScroll wrapper to silence Lenis positioning warning.
(Optional) Consider periodic cleanup of orphaned entries in db.uploads and /app/backend/uploads_tmp.
Verified: no action required for backend contract or admin editor flow — all green.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py (838 lines) is on the edge — recommend splitting into routers (auth, admin_site, uploads, products, facs) if more features are added.
merge_site only merges top-level keys and shallow-merges dicts; nested dicts (e.g. hero.cta) lose keys if partial dict is sent. Current admin UI sends full objects so OK today, but worth documenting.

upload_chunk writes with seek+write but does not validate the size of a non-final chunk equals CHUNK_SIZE (only caps upper bound). If a client sends a short middle chunk, the file ends up corrupt but still passes received-set membership. Mitigation: compare final tmp.stat().st_size to up['size'] — which IS done in complete(). Good.
clean_doc only strips _id at the top level; nested documents (modules/lessons) are serialized through BSON but currently have no nested _id since they are inserted as plain dicts with uuid 'id'. OK.
No rate limiting on /api/admin/uploads/init — admin role gated, so acceptable.

seed_data_creation: Backend tests create and delete their own TEST_ data (fac, upload). No persistent seed data left behind. One stray test png may remain in /api/admin/uploads from the Playwright run (safe to leave; was deleted by test but table showed 13 pre-existing seed images).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file is /app/backend/tests/test_backend.py — run with `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_backend.py -v`. All mutating endpoints require Origin header equal to REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL / CORS_ORIGINS. Uploads use 4MB chunks via PUT /api/admin/uploads/{id}/chunk/{index} with application/octet-stream body. Site editor flow verified: edit→save→reflect on public → reset works end-to-end.
rca of the issue: No blocking issues found. Minor cosmetic/console warnings documented above.
